nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: TikTok Intelligence ET: list Product API.

categoryKeywordCN.description: Product classification (please enter Chinese). Maximum length 1000

keyword.description: Product keywords (please translate into local language). Maximum length 1000

maxFirstCrawlDt.description: Product shelf time (maximum value), format YYYYMMDD

maxProductCommissionRate.description: Product commission ratio (maximum value), when the input value is a percentage, it will automatically be converted into a decimal, for example: 5%->0.05

maxTotalVideoCnt.description: Number of videos with goods (maximum value)

maxTotalViewsCnt.description: Number of plays with goods (maximum value)

minFirstCrawlDt.description: Product shelf time (minimum value), format YYYYMMDD (for example: 20200101 represents 2020-01-01)

minProductCommissionRate.description: Product commission ratio (minimum value), when the input value is a percentage, it will automatically be converted into a decimal, for example: 5%->0.05

minTotalViewsCnt.description: Number of plays with goods (minimum value)

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Default `50`

productSortField.description: Sorting fields: 1=total sales volume, 2=total merchandise transaction volume, 3=SPU average price, 4=7-day sales volume, 5=30-day sales volume, 6=7-day merchandise transaction volume, 7=30-day merchandise transaction volume. Default `1`

region.description: Region, default `US`. Optional values: US (United States), ID (Indonesia), TH (Thailand), PH (Philippines), MY (Malaysia), VN (Vietnam), GB (UK), MX (Mexico), SG (Singapore), SA (Saudi Arabia), BR (Brazil), ES (Spain), JP (Japan), DE (Germany), IT (Italy), FR (France)

saleDays.description: The number of days the product has been on sale, in days
